name: rule1118-04-syndic-ashen-dies
note: Caden (Nov 18 card): "If an ashen player joins the syndic then the syndic automatically dies the following night." The Syndic invites Mab (Ashen) at L1; Mab accepts (an Ashen may refuse, Caden Nov 18 8:33) and gets no recruit shield; the Syndic dies at the start of the next Ash Fall (logged for the GM; counts as a death). The Overseer shield from AF1 has already expired by then (shields end after the Lumination), and the AF2 shield comes too late, so in practice protection cannot reach this death; the code also skips protection checks for it (question for Caden).

logIncludes: Ashen recruits get no shield (Caden, Nov 18)
The Syndic will die automatically the following Ash Fall
